scripts.build:cli: bun run prepare:uv && bun build --compile --asset vendor/uv src/main.ts --outfile dist/bundlr
scripts.build:cli:windows: bun run prepare:uv x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --asset vendor/uv src/main.ts --outfile dist/bundlr-windows-x86_64.exe
scripts.desktop:build: bun run prepare:uv && bun build --compile --asset vendor/uv src/desktop.ts --outfile dist/bundlr-desktop
scripts.lint:format: biome ci --assist-enabled=false src scripts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.format: biome format --write src scripts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
